profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ SiriusXM | Staff JavaScript Engineer | AWS Cloud
profile.summary:
Lead Software Engineer with over 13+ years of hands-on experience in Software Engineering, System Design, JavaScript Development, mentoring, and Cloud Architecture. 

I've improved the data processing of my client's most important security applications by an 85% delivery time, this application is currently displaying approximately 500,000 values in the form of GPS heart bits per request, allowing the security team to find valuables in real-time and most importantly had a direct impact on faster decision-making. Additionally, I improved my client's client management application processes by 30%, making the process flow more simpler and efficient for our users. Letting the user deliver faster responses to their client base, and having better customer service.

One of the achievements that I take great pride in is leading the delivery of a high-value market-facing application that met 100% of expectations, even within a challenging time frame of just 2 months. Throughout this process, I worked on setting an end-to-end architecture to ensure we delivered a performance-focused solution and spared no effort in implementing the latest JavaScript technologies to ensure the best results for our end users.

As a leader, I've had the privilege of managing diverse teams in multiple countries. My focus has always been on fostering a strong team spirit and the continuous development of top-notch software. I am committed to empowering my team and being readily available to support their growth and success.

Proficient in Javascript/Typescript and Angular, I'm passionate about driving innovation and achieving results in every project I undertake.

Competencies: Javascript/Typescript, Python, PHP, Angular, React, AWS (AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner), Google Cloud, MongoDB, DynamoDB, SQLServer, AuroraDB, MySQL, PostgresSQL.

I'm always looking to grow my personal and professional network. Feel free to connect via LinkedIn

positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Document Automation & Internal Platform Systems

• Technical lead for a mission-critical internal platform that automates document creation, synchronization, and governance across Jira, Google Drive (Docs), Slack, and internal services.

• Designed and owned a distributed, event-driven architecture using Node.js and TypeScript, with secure webhook ingestion, deterministic workflows, and strong consistency across external systems.

• Built a secure Google Drive integration using Service Accounts to enable scalable document cloning, template transformation, metadata enforcement, and controlled access without user-level OAuth.

• Architected a document automation pipeline that:
    - Clones and customizes templates at scale
    - Performs structured placeholder and content transformations
    - Validates and reconciles document state across systems
    - Feeds normalized content into an OpenAI-powered pipeline to train client-facing AI assistants capable of answering questions across all imported documents

• Established operational excellence through audit logs, Slack-based alerting, and health dashboards, significantly reducing manual effort and operational risk.

• Acted as the primary technical owner, driving cross-team alignment, setting architectural standards, and mentoring engineers through design and code reviews.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a core contributor to the OESA (Ops Eng Solutions Applications) team, I lead the design, development, and deployment of scalable, cloud-based tools that elevate both user experience and operational efficiency across the organization.

• Developed and extended a high-impact internal application that provides organization-wide access to SiriusXM user account data. This system enables greater transparency and user control over account details, contributing to improved user satisfaction and reduced support overhead. The platform leverages a React + Redux front-end and a Node.js + AWS Lambda back-end, with infrastructure-as-code and automated deployment pipelines integrated through GitHub Actions.

• Designed and implemented a full-stack debugging and enhancement platform used by the Search team to streamline app testing, debugging, and performance tuning. Built using React, Redux, Node.js, and TypeScript, the application runs on AWS infrastructure and is equipped with CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, ensuring robust scalability, maintainability, and fast iteration cycles.

• Actively contribute to end-to-end architecture decisions, advocate for modern development practices, and mentor junior developers on full-stack best practices, particularly in JavaScript/TypeScript, component-driven UI, API design, cloud-native development, and CI/CD workflows.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
I am leading 3 of my client’s core applications, where I managed both the front-end team and architecture. By prioritizing industry-leading standards in JavaScript/TypeScript, and Redux, I have continuously improved the code base while keeping the user experience as a priority.

• Designed and developed robust, scalable, and efficient software solutions in accordance with industry best practices and architectural guidelines.
• Coordinate with and assign tasks to front-end capable developers on the team, performing code reviews and ensuring quality.
• Manage and mentor Jr. Developers. Ensured that they understood what is expected in the code base and developed their own skills in the process.
• Help structure and set the CI/CD process for all environments each application has.
• Developed the front-end architecture meant to work with services created by Boston Consulting Group.
• Responsible for clarifying requirements, setting development expectations, adhering to client standards.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description:
I led one of my client's most important security applications, which allowed the security team to take care of their assets and make quick decisions in real-time. By updating the tech stack and refactoring the code base I was able to improve the data delivery and display time 85% faster. 

• I was responsible for working with the business team through the design process, clarifying requirements, setting development expectations, and following client standards.
• I've improved the data processing and display by an 85% delivery time, this application is currently displaying approximately 500,000 values in the form of GPS heart bits per request
• I coordinated the front-end team, performing code reviews, and ensuring the quality of the code base by creating style and code guidelines and by making sure all expectations of each feature were clear.
• I made sure proper test cases and code coverage practices were applied.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineering
positions.description:
I was part of the development team in charge of refactoring one of our client's core API libraries. I worked on redesigning this function library from old JavaScript to TypeScript, making sure best practices were in place. I was able to deliver a 35% improvement in the response and development process.  

• I redesigned the current architecture of the API to meet a new one using Typescript and made sure it maintained compatibility with older versions.
• I mentored developers in TypeScript best practices by creating some guidelines, sharing resources, and making sure all this was applied in the code base through code reviews.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Developer for the Seller Center Team, a platform developed for Linio’s sellers where they can manage their products, and track their orders and sales in real-time. I was in charge of developing and maintaining both the front and back end of the application, applying PHP with Zend Framework, MySQL, Docker, and JavaScript.

• I worked on improving the architecture of the application, achieving results of 35% faster response times and data handling, enabling faster communication between sellers and buyers.
• I led the development of the “Deals” section on Seller Center, having always in mind the best user experience for the sellers. I made sure both the front and the back of the application applied leading practices.
• I mentored the developer in web development best practices by creating code and style guidelines, making sure this was applied in every feature created throw code reviews.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.locationName: Bahía de San Francisco y alrededores, Estados Unidos · Hybrid
positions.description:
Designed and created the front and back end components for the Focal Systems’ Dashboard application used by our Shelf Cams and Out-of-Stock system. Worked on making data loading times 25% faster by applying a cloud serverless architecture using Google Cloud. 

• I improved all front and backend components applying industry best practices for both NodeJS with React, achieving a 25% better loading time. 
• I migrated and configured new servers in Google Cloud for future platform scalability.
• I led the Out-of-Stock application used by Focal’s clients to tell in real-time the status of their merchandise.
• I created the architecture of the Out-of-Stock API for other Focal Systems’ applications be able to access this information.
